name: Rosewood San Miguel Allende
positioning: Rosewood San Miguel de Allende, a city hotel on a quieter side street in central San Miguel, with artisan-crafted rooms, a rooftop restaurant and a garden kitchen
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base in central San Miguel
Guests interested in art, cooking classes and local cultural experiences

facts.text: The location is central but on a quieter side street, about a 10-minute walk from the church and the Jardin Allende.
The hotel opened in 2011 as Rosewood's first city hotel in Mexico.
The hotel is a new build.
1826 Restaurant serves modern interpretations of Mexico's culinary heritage, with indoor or al fresco dining.
Luna Rooftop draws inspiration from Mediterranean cuisine while celebrating Mexican ingredients.
Pirules Garden Kitchen offers wood-fired dining led by Chef Odin Rocha, with ingredients from local producers.
At Pirules, Chef Odin Rocha sources ingredients within 60 miles of the hotel.
Colonial Rooms have a bathroom with a soaking tub and a private balcony.
All three room categories have a balcony or terraces.
Rooms use locally crafted furniture and hand-carved finishes.
The spa, Sense, A Rosewood Spa, has a steam room, a sauna and relaxation rooms.

highlights.text: The Parroquia Suite is a one-bedroom suite with dual fireplaces and a terrace looking out to San Miguel's church.
An art concierge can arrange painting classes and art experiences throughout the city.
A horseback ride descends into a canyon and ends at a natural river.
A cultural experience takes guests to a traditional San Miguel workshop to make their own miniature Mojigangas figure.
Cooking classes can be paired with a visit to the local farm where the hotel sources much of its produce.

considerations.text: The hotel feels like a resort, and it is tempting to spend all your time on the grounds, which may not suit every visitor to San Miguel.
WhataHotel notes the colonial streets are steep and uneven, which may be hard for guests with limited mobility.
WhataHotel notes the town is inland in the highlands with no beach access.
